$comment: Gzipped bytes. entry: the entry chunk with its static imports; routes: a route file's split chunks with the static imports the entry does not already load; css: all emitted CSS. A task that needs more raises the budget in the same PR and says why. U-02 raised entry from 150000 to 175000: the authenticated shell (sidebar, engine switcher, trust mark with SHA-256, user menu, drawer, step-up dialog, toaster, route states) and the Paraglide runtime with both catalogues render on every route, so they belong in the entry; measured 168130. Raised to 200000 on 2026-10-21 (Seb): at 173803 an audit of the entry found it is framework and contract code (react-dom, zod, TanStack Router and Query, engine-api schemas, @ptbk/ui shell components); Paraglide already tree-shakes messages per route, and the only engine-ui code left to split was route loaders (about 1 kB), not worth a serial chunk fetch before every cold navigation.
